key_takeaways: 이 게시물은 낮은 참여도(9점, 댓글 0개)를 보입니다.
모든 앱을 서로 연결하는 개념을 언급하며, 광범위한 통합 트렌드를 암시합니다.

en.title: Hacker News: Connecting every app to every other app
en.hook: A brief Hacker News post spotlights the vision of universal app interoperability—could this be the next big integration standard?
key_takeaways: The post shows low engagement (9 points, 0 comments).
It mentions the concept of connecting every app to every other app, hinting at a broader integration trend.
It serves as a reminder of the ongoing challenge and interest in app interoperability.

zh.title: Hacker News：连接每个应用到其他应用
zh.hook: 一篇简短的Hacker News帖子展现了通用应用互操作性的愿景——这是否会成为下一个大的集成标准？
key_takeaways: 该帖子显示参与度较低（9分，0条评论）。
它提到了将每个应用连接到其他应用的概念，暗示了更广泛的集成趋势。
它提醒我们关注持续存在的应用互操作性挑战和兴趣。
